runtime_profile_summary: Python 3.11 venv at /opt/benchmark/venv with RavenPy installed in editable mode with dev dependencies. GDAL and raven-hydro installed as special dependencies.
test_runner_reachability_evidence: pytest 9.1.0 collected 116 tests from core test files. GIS-related test files have import errors due to optional gis dependencies not being installed, but core tests including test_commands.py (which tests CustomOutput) are fully functional.
notes: RavenPy environment successfully created. The setup script installs GDAL (requires libgdal-dev, gdal-bin, python3-dev system packages), raven-hydro, and RavenPy with dev dependencies. Some GIS-related test modules fail to import due to missing optional GIS dependencies (geopandas, rasterio, etc.), but core functionality including the CustomOutput tests are available. The environment uses a venv at /opt/benchmark/venv with activation via 'source /opt/benchmark/venv/bin/activate'.
